notes:
A new REPORTS section on the home screen. Print protel's Departure List by Time to the Microsoft XPS Document Writer, save it into the reports folder, and it appears here: preview it with the guest names withheld — everything else exactly as protel printed it, departure times and board included — print it from inside the tool, or delete it to the Recycle Bin. Nothing is sent to protel.

Also in this build: the room movements panel is ARRIVALS, DEPARTURES, MOVES with cyan move pills; the dot and the LEFT TODAY mark take a receipt whose name opens the departing guest's; each receipt is named after its own guest; names refresh in place when the in-house list is captured.
